full_judgment: 6. Mr. Khandker Mahbub Hossain, learned advocate appearing for the appellants submits ,that the learned judges of the High Court Division failed to exercise their judicial discretion while rejecting the prayer of bail as because acquittal not only strengthens the presumption of innocence but also negatives the existence of any reasonable ground for believing that the accused persons were guilty of the offence.
